fusions.name: Pelting Streaks
fusions.desc: Looses 4 streams at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage. Each hit has a 30% chance of [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Cloudburst
fusions.desc: Drops a heavy bolt of rain on the first enemy it meets, dealing 30 damage to it and 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, ignoring resistances.

fusions.name: Steady Downpour
fusions.desc: Restores 18 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Collected Drops
fusions.desc: Every time you cast, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once and heal you. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
